r3-evidence.title: Required evidence
r3-evidence.imperative: Is the required evidence present and does it actually demonstrate the behavior? Record pass/fail with a finding.
r3-evidence.finding: Re-ran both required commands myself (not trusting the pasted tail): 'pytest test_systematic_budget.py -q' -> 18 passed; 'pytest tests/unit/physics/layer2/ -q -k systematic' -> 20 passed, matching IMPLEMENTER_RESULT exactly. KEY JUDGMENT (fallback validation adequacy), independently assessed: (1) genuinely closed-form pieces ARE independently unit-tested against their closed forms -- mass 1:1 verified via PowerDragView.design()'s 1/mass-uniform column scaling (I re-derived: OLS coef scales linearly with mass when both design columns share a 1/m factor) and cross-checked by test_cda_mass_sensitivity_is_one_to_one's 2x-doubling assertion; CdA-pin Jacobian (a_b/b_b/a_t/b_t) reuses braking_view.py's own documented closed form directly, not re-derived; theta_R intercept 1:1 verified against the literal cov[0,0] += theta_R.sigma**2 code in both views; A0/A2 zero is provable-by-inspection (lateral_view.py has no mass/rho/theta_R references at all) and is the most safety-critical claim (Protected Intent: 'do NOT reuse the blind 4%') -- this is solid. (2) THETA_SENS_CDA_REL, RHO_SENS_PMAX_REL, THETA_SENS_PMAX_REL are NOT closed-form by the module's own admission (no clean closed form exists for these couplings) -- they are back-solved algebraically from the single pre-existing SYSTEMATIC_FLOOR reference number (4.3%/3.7%), and I independently recomputed the derivation arithmetic (sqrt(4.3^2-2.4752^2-1.5^2)/100=0.0318012 vs literal 0.031801; sqrt(3.7^2-2.4752^2)/sqrt(2)/100=0.0194463 vs literal 0.019446) -- transcription is correct, no arithmetic bug, but NO unit test recomputes this formula against the literal (a cheap, currently-missing regression guard). More importantly: theta_R's CdA contribution is ~55% of the CdA total's variance, and the P_max rho/theta_R split is an explicitly-admitted arbitrary 50/50 (underdetermined from one equation, two unknowns) -- so the SHARED-vs-SESSION split for CdA/P_max (the Protected-Intent-critical, must-be-computed-not-guessed deliverable) is NOT independently validated beyond self-consistency with one old reference number; only the TOTAL is anchored to real history, not the channel attribution. VERDICT: adequate to pass g1's own close criteria (the handoff explicitly sanctioned exactly this fallback, the reproduction is not 'ONLY' a bare constant-equals-constant assertion since mass/rho-width channels are genuinely computed from real per-session inputs, and the gap is extensively self-disclosed as provisional in 3 places: module docstring, IMPLEMENTER_RESULT Map Impact, and a named triage candidate) -- but this is a load-bearing gap G4 MUST NOT silently inherit as validated fact. Flagging as a mandatory triage/decision item, not a silent pass.

r6-fowler.imperative: Run the refactoring / code-smell pass (SKILL.md 'Refactoring pass'). Smells are judgment calls, ALWAYS subordinate to the repo's documented standards — an override needs a logged standard + reason. Record the pass to templates/FOWLER_PASS.template.json, run scripts/verify_fowler_pass.py <record> (it refuses a skipped smell or an unlogged override), then record pass/fail with a finding. Do NOT silently skip this item.
